title: Atheistical
summary: ATHEIST'ICAL, a. 1. Pertaining to atheism.2. Disbelieving the existence of a God; impious, applied to persons; as, an atheistic writer.3. Implying or containing atheism; applied to things, as, atheist

inlines.v: ATHEIST'ICAL, a. 1. Pertaining to atheism.2. Disbelieving the existence of a God; impious, applied to persons; as, an atheistic writer.3. Implying or containing atheism; applied to things, as, atheistic doctrines or opinions.
